activity.notes: Elizabeth Báthory was a powerful Hungarian countess and magnate, not a sovereign ruler of 'Royal Hungary'. ATLAS therefore reuses the Kingdom of Hungary polity but records an active_in/general_activity relationship rather than rules/governs. The interval begins with her 1575 marriage into the Nádasdy household and ends with her confinement in 1610; it is a biographical-public-status interval, not a reign.

sources.title: Báthory Erzsébet és bűnpere — Magyar Nemzeti Levéltár
sources.citation_text: The Hungarian National Archives treats Báthory Erzsébet as a major historical figure, documents her 1610 will and confinement, and notes continuing historical debate over the accusations against her.

sources.title: Elizabeth Bathory — Biography.com
sources.citation_text: The biography records her 1575 marriage, status as a wealthy Hungarian countess, management of extensive estates, and confinement in 1610.
